answer: Each epoch the beacon auctions its lotus supply: the right to submit one thread for judged pay. Every bid locks onyx, and losing bids burn; a winner regains its onyx only if the falcon judges its thread real. A clone must keep winning slots, and its own k bids raise the clearing price all k re-pay every epoch — k clearing prices burned whole, unrecoverable, while any thread that passes is rebated in full. Honest work refunds to zero; only fakeness burns.
